analysis_metadata.pr_title: Fix critical vulnerability CVE-2021-45046 in log4j-core (shop module)
analysis_metadata.scope: CVE-2021-45046 remediation - log4j-core and log4j-api upgrade from 2.6.1 to 2.17.1 in shop module

test_module.note: test/pom.xml still references log4j 2.6.1 - not addressed by this PR

instruments_module.note: Version managed by Spring Boot BOM, Spring Boot 2.7.5 ships log4j 2.17.2+

security_analysis.overall_assessment: PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED - shop module fixed, test module still vulnerable with log4j 2.6.1

compatibility.spring_boot_1_5_19: COMPATIBLE - Log4j 2.17.1 is backward compatible with Spring Boot 1.5.x. The shop module uses SLF4J for logging; log4j-api and log4j-core are explicit dependencies that do not conflict with Spring Boot managed logging.
compatibility.transitive_conflicts: NONE DETECTED - Build completed successfully with all 8 modules passing

dependency_impact_analysis.build_verification: BUILD SUCCESS - All 8 reactor modules compiled and tests passed after the version upgrade
